## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spec.connectionRef` | string | no | `"default"` | connectionRef is the name of the ZitiConnection to use. It defaults to "default". |
| `spec.identityRef` | string | yes |  | identityRef is the name of an enrolled ZitiIdentity in this namespace. Minimum length 1. Maximum length 253. |
| `spec.port` | integer | yes |  | port is the local port the proxy listens on inside the pod. Forward a workstation port to it with kubectl port-forward deployment/&lt;resource-name&gt; &lt;local-port&gt;:&lt;port&gt;. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `spec.service` | string | yes |  | service is the Ziti service name to dial. Minimum length 1. Maximum length 1000. |

## Validation rules

The API server rejects a resource that breaks one of these rules.

- `spec`: identityRef is immutable
- `spec`: service is immutable
- `spec`: port is immutable

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: ziti.alialjaffer.com/v1alpha1
kind: ZitiPortForward
metadata:
  name: billing
  namespace: team-a
spec:
  identityRef: billing-client
  service: billing
  port: 8080
```
